business_summary: Techno Horizon Co.,Ltd. engages in the video and IT, and robotics businesses in Japan, Singapore, Malaysia, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers optical equipment, such as document cameras/visualizers, electronic whiteboards, and surveillance cameras. It also provides robot control equipment, automatic soldering equipment, X-ray visual inspection equipment, production equipment, optical units, commercial automotive equipment, and medical equipment. In addition, the company is involved in contract software development and sales; sales and installation of AV equipment and systems; and sales, installation, maintenance, and support for cybersecurity equipment and software. Further, it engages in the development, sales, and support of ICT-based English learning materials for young children; operation of an online cram and preparatory school; planning, development, sales, operation, and maintenance of SchoolMaster Zeus; and IT-related staffing, help desk, and operational support. Additionally, the company offers laser-related products; school administration consulting and technical support services for schools; liquefied gas-powered cordless heating tools and soldering iron tips; consulting services for university management; comprehensive planning and promotion services for recruitment, public relations, and career development; industrial cameras, image input boards, and small projectors; computer components, devices for controlling injection molding removal machines, robot controllers, and computer numerical control machines; factory automation-related equipment, including numerical control devices and printed circuit board inspection equipment; resin molded parts; sensors; and business management and image processing software. Techno Horizon Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
